description: Na₂Ti₂O₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.34 Å. Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with five equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.86 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Ti atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ti trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
